summary: Cloudflare service adapters; domain authority and transport-neutral ports stay in shared packages.

key_files.project-content.ts: Default D1 exact-admission/owner/tenant/deletion authorization, ProjectRoom snapshot reader, tenant-scoped immutable R2 Resource registry, and capability-use resolver. Registry facts are private infrastructure, not another Asset authority.
key_files.project-content-cloud.ts: D1/R2/ProjectRoom ports for the shared upload service and capability resolver. Adds the owner/tenant preview branch, signed chunked-import staging branch, and a bounded per-isolate capability cache.
key_files.project-asset-room.ts: ProjectRoom-side Project Asset adapter, lazily imported by the DO. Reads run on the live doc; commits re-check ownership inside the import queue, mutate a fork, then import/persist/broadcast only the new update. importProjectAsset is the one fork commit, shared with Timeline render publication.
key_files.project-asset-resources.ts: Worker-side Resource sealing shared by the Project Asset routes and video_render staging: effective tenant, digest of staged R2 bytes, first-wins registry claim and placement at the Resource locator.
key_files.project-content-multipart.ts: R2-only adapter for the optional shared multipart storage port: authenticated target-bound sessions, immutable part receipts, CAS publication ownership, incremental SHA-256 and streamed checksum-verified canonical writes. Sessions expire after 24 hours; the existing cron advances a bounded cleanup cursor. Upload IDs and private locators never grant authorization. Empty digest marks private Asset-import staging.
key_files.cloud-project-admission.ts: D1 atomic-batch persistence adapter over shared cloud admission service; guards owner, tenant and deletion.
key_files.cloud-asset-delivery.ts: Cloud signing-secret and external-origin adapter for Resource capabilities.
key_files.asset-signing.ts: JWT_SECRET binding of the shared shared-runtime/signed-capability helper for /assets/<key>?exp=&sig= URLs. Signs with no domain prefix so the URL format and every issued signature stay byte-identical; asset-signing.test.ts pins it against node:crypto HMAC.
key_files.thumbnail.ts: renderServerFetch: the one transport to render-server (RENDER_SERVER_URL or the RENDER_CONTAINER binding). The /render protocol itself is shared-runtime/render-server.
key_files.provider-task-boundaries.test.ts: Captured protocol regressions for explicit hosted provider submit/status checks, opaque token reuse and transient HTTP classification.
key_files.minimax-video.ts: Hosted request/credential translation over the shared portable MiniMax executor; no blocking poll loop.
key_files.settings-d1.ts: D1-backed settings and historical installed-record reads/removal. Worker Action manifest installation returns structured 410 before any D1 access; real executable installation belongs to Local Host.
key_files.cloud-plugin-packages.ts: Bundled plugin packages (static JSON imports) and the executable projection surfaces of the hosted Worker. Lazy-only: never import from the startup graph.
key_files.cloud-plugin-catalog.ts: Builds the catalog on first use after registering the generated precompiled Generator validators (workerd forbids Ajv runtime compilation).
key_files.provider-accounts.ts: D1 provider accounts with AES-GCM credential envelopes shared through @clash/shared-runtime/provider-credentials; public rows expose only configured credential key names.
key_files.provider-usage.ts: D1 append-only provider usage audit using INSERT OR IGNORE on the stable event id, so retries cannot duplicate a charge row.
